hints.title: Divisibility Counting
hints.text: For each candidate divisor, count how many numbers in nums are divisible by it.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Policy
hints.text: When two divisors yield the same divisibility count, pick the numerically smaller divisor.

hints.title: Iterate Candidates
hints.text: Evaluate all divisors sequentially while tracking maximum count and best divisor.

hints.title: Divisibility Score Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct calculation of divisibility score across all candidate divisors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs is minimal and fits within constraints (m, n <= 1000).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles tie breaking by choosing minimum divisor.
